ragSuggestions:
FAQ · collections.3f6cc9c3d774 — I lost my job / I am in financial hardship. What are my options?

I am sorry you are going through this. We can schedule a hardship-review callback so a specialist can discuss options. If you prefer, I can also connect you to a human agent now.

HDFC Retail Collections — Benefits — HDFC Retail Collections — Benefits

HDFC Retail Collections — caller benefits summary (agent reference)

- Clear dues by the statement due date to avoid late fees where applicable.
- Set a promise-to-pay with a concrete date when you need a few more days.
- Request a hardship-review callback if you face job loss or medical emergency.
- Update auto-debit mandates after an EMI bounce to reduce repeat failures.
- After full clearance, request NOC / account-closure documentation through
 the normal fulfilment process (not same-day guaranteed on the call).
- Speak only to the verified account holder; third parties cannot receive
 balance details.

HDFC Retail Collections — Policy — EMI bounce / failed auto-debit

When an EMI or auto-debit fails (insufficient funds, closed account, mandate
issue), the installment remains outstanding and bounce charges may apply as
per the product schedule. Offer to schedule a promise-to-pay or a callback for
mandate update — do not promise charge reversal on the call.

HDFC Retail Collections — Policy — Hardship

If the customer discloses financial hardship (job loss, medical emergency),
acknowledge empathetically, offer a callback for hardship review, and escalate
when distress is severe. Do not pressure for immediate full payment.

Absolutely, transferring you to a human agent now — please hold.
Hi, this is Aarav. I've reviewed the notes — how can I help?
Your reminders are too frequent. Stop them or I'm closing the card.
I've registered a DND for voice reminders and reduced SMS to weekly only.
Is there anything else I can help you with today? Thank you for your time.
